svg.text: The outer boundary of a critical percolation hull and a self-avoiding walk on the honeycomb both have mass dimension 4/3.
Percolation hull, L = 128: 7011 steps (gray); external perimeter in rust
black arc: left and top; white arc: bottom and right
Honeycomb SAW, n = 700, same scale (pivot sample, seed 43)
open dots: card 237 exact counts, n ≤ 40
Theorems (triangular-lattice site percolation): exploration path to SLE(6) (Smirnov; Camia-Newman); SLE(k) has dimension 1+k/8, so 7/4 (Beffara);
the outer boundary of SLE(6) is SLE(8/3)-like (Lawler-Schramm-Werner), dimension 4/3. Physics: 4/3 for the accessible perimeter (Aizenman-Duplantier-Aharony).
Conjecture: the uniform SAW scaling limit is SLE(8/3). Card 237 covers only the honeycomb exponent 3/4. Perimeter rule: one-site necks closed.
Finite simulations illustrate, they do not prove.
